results.strFilename: NHL 2026-11-12 Seattle Kraken vs Carolina Hurricanes
results.strDescriptionEN: Seattle Kraken and Carolina Hurricanes open the 2026 NHL Global Series Finland at Veikkaus Arena in Helsinki. Carolina arrive as the defending Stanley Cup champions and one of the league’s strongest teams, while Seattle make their first regular-season appearance outside North America. With several Finnish players returning home and Taylor Hall playing his 1,000th NHL game, the matchup carries significant international interest.
results.strResult: Carolina Hurricanes defeated Seattle Kraken 4-1 in the opening game of the 2026 NHL Global Series Finland in Helsinki. Sebastian Aho scored twice in his home country, while Nikolaj Ehlers and Juuso Valimaki also found the net for Carolina. Seattle avoided the shutout through Frederick Gaudreau, but Carolina controlled the game and outshot the Kraken 30-13.
